description.value: Pane E Formaggio is a family-owned artisanal bakery in downtown Vancouver that has been crafting sourdough breads, pastries, and sweet treats using traditional recipes since 2005. The bakery maintains a decade-old sourdough starter and sources ingredients from local farmers committed to sustainability. Beyond walk-in retail, it offers catering and wholesale services, and provides both indoor and outdoor seating for customers.
